slice.rationale: This slice is minimal and demonstrable because it enables the essential functionality of creating and retrieving notes, showcasing the basic end-to-end flow of the application. It allows the owner to verify both data creation and retrieval, which are fundamental operations for any notes management system, thereby demonstrating core system functionality.
